Thrashes on test 00200 for a very long span, rewriting test_shift.c repeatedly (2691-2715) without bounding effort or moving on — failed thrash-detection, the opposite of anchor 8's stuck-recognition.

reasoning: The agent keeps a genuine running tally — full-suite reruns after almost every change, numeric trend tracking (36->16), and per-suite pass breakdowns it uses to redirect effort — which matches anchor 5's 'running tally of pass counts by suite/feature.' However, it shows no explicit regression detection (weakening 5's second clause) and, most notably, fails anchor 8's thrash-bounding by looping on test 00200 for hundreds of steps with repeated repro rewrites instead of recognizing the stall and moving on. That combination places it right at level 5, not higher.
